## Before opening this PR

- [ ] `make pr-check` reports 0 errors. The Pages build runs the same check and fails the PR otherwise.
- [ ] Each new or edited lesson has a `description`, a `permalink`, and, if it is an assignment, `assignment_creator_uids` with your GitHub login.
- [ ] Any permalink I changed has a redirect (`make lesson-update` adds one automatically).
- [ ] I opened the changed pages locally (`make dev`) and they render.
